ios.desc:
All the town wants to duel with you. 
Last in town is a strategy and action game.
Become the most feared gunslinger in the land by defeating all who stand in your way. Use your reflexes against computer opponents in western gunfight battles.

Take on the best shooters in the west. 
Can you send them all to the cemetery without dying?

Think wisely, every opponent is different. 
Sometimes you have to shoot fast. 
Sometimes you have to wait... 
You have three choices (shoot, protect, reload). 

There is a time to shoot and a time to reload. 
All duels have a different strategy, be smart.
But you will be vulnerable when reloading or shooting... be careful.

Only one will stay alive. 
Manage your stress and shoot at the perfect time. 
Only one will survive in each level.

This fun game has been made using flutter and flame.
